scope: Rename pr-review-draft to pr-review with direct publication, and add pr-review-followup.
userDecisions: Publish reviews directly instead of leaving a PENDING draft; name the skill pr-review.
Publish as Comment with findings, Approve when clean; never Request changes.

Follow reviewed PRs every 30 minutes; continue same-topic points in their thread; ask for a ticket on a deferral and resolve once confirmed; run the full review on every new head; approve once everything is settled.

checks.result: read-only probe returned threads, author, base branch and verification state; no writes

reviews.outcome: 11 and about 20 findings; approval, idempotency, identity, pagination and ticket-settlement findings adopted; Claude disable-model-invocation rejected because pr-review-followup invokes pr-review and scheduled ticks invoke pr-review-followup.
5 and 5 findings adopted: one approval predicate, head-scoped verification, open questions, settle, base-branch binding, --max-event COMMENT.
4 and 2 findings adopted: gate on the approval's own read, expected_base_ref, no reopen-and-verify, reassessment after a new head.
No material defect; two minor items fixed: one completeness predicate, stale-approval rerun error.
